name: fly44_l_v4
description: Fly walking-bout filters (fly44_l_V4 skeleton, rectangular chamber). This skeleton has no T1L_TaTip (left front leg is tracked only to the coxa, T1L_ThxCx) - only 5 of the usual 6 leg tips are available. Filter logic runs natively in RED; this file only supplies the species/rig mapping.
_comment_scale: Unlike elliot_abe's Fly50 pipeline (jarvis_predict_export.h, raw units = 10x mm), the cluster JARVIS pipeline's keypoints3d.csv (imported via red3d_import.h) is already calibrated in the same units as the DLT calibration files under clusterfly/calibration -- i.e. already mm, no /10 needed. Verified by reprojecting a floor-plane arena corner (23.5, 5.5, 0.4) through the real Posts39a_July6 Cam2012630 DLT calibration: it lands at pixel (1897.65, 446.94), essentially exactly at the edge of that camera's real 1936x448 frame -- the expected result for a corner of the physical corridor. Confidence is NOT scaled.
_comment_keypoints: Names must exist in the loaded skeleton. body_ref is the posture/speed reference (thorax/scutellum). Only 5 leg tips: fly44_l_V4 has no T1L_TaTip.
_comment_defaults: Filter defaults RED loads into the UI. Live edits in RED override these; 'Reset to profile defaults' restores them.
